points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight canonical packages and report passed prior structural validator; source-to-run identity remains unproven and output visual limitations documented.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior validator returned rc0 for all eight final directories and report; it does not establish target-miss truth or identify producing binary.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 reaches t300 with periodic lift, seven steady statuses converged; source-to-run revision and strict transient target claims are unverified.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Raw force tails/periods are documented; M0.15 inviscid Cd 0.0344 and laminar Cd 0.0118, gradient damping and Re200 lift amplitude suggest limitations without an independent grid study.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Three inviscid case plots show force evolution and contours; four steady viscous force plots and Re200 late drag are compressed by startup spikes. Figures remain traceable through report manifest.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: The 41-page report is detailed and candid about reconstruction blending, but does not disclose the M2 inviscid CFD_GRAD_DAMP=0.5 production setting.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Final verification notes uncommitted solver edits and case metadata git_revision=null, so exact production binary source is not proven. Run manifest and figures identify canonical paths.
